The gates aren't meant to be fixed % regardless of work - they're checkpoints. The actual progress within each gate should come from deliverables completed (like you suggested).

So "Dev Build" isn't just "35%" sitting there - it's "Dev Build: 12/20 tasks done = 21% of total" (60% of that gate's weight).

That way we get both: high-level structure (which gate are we in?) + granular progress (how far through that gate?)
